_meta.source: Reporters Without Borders (RSF), World Press Freedom Index
_meta.scale: 0–100, higher = more press freedom; rank 1 = most free
_meta.note: Fetched from RSF's published CSV by scripts/fetch_rsf.py, with no hand-typed figures. Sub-indicator scores (political, economic, legal, social, safety) are RSF's own five-context breakdown.
